description: LS2_RT_LS_NZ_magra is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by dati.lamma.toscana.it. Landslide and PAI datasets in the Magra basin, harmonised according to the Inspire Natural Risks Zones scheme. Coverage: IT. Its keywords include INSPIRE, Life-IMAGINE. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
